coverage.denominator: all cells in this rectangular geographic query window; includes sea and sometimes other jurisdictions; not provincial land completeness
coverage.cloud_note: not applicable: this environmental product has no cloud class

preview_note: Zero-height cells are transparent in preview (usually ocean); numerical grid preserves source zero. Not a coastline or verified land mask.
native_resolution: 1 arcsecond (~30 m latitude); source DSM, not bare-earth terrain
period: TanDEM-X mainly 2011–2015; infill can be older; catalog 2021 publication is not observation date
coverage_note: The source tile exists but this entire window has only zero-height cells. Do not treat this as measured island terrain.
